title: Symmetry-Breaking De Novo Crystal Generation via Markovian Jump Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.13457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating crystals has recently attracted significant interest due to their broad applications in materials science. However, existing generative models struggle to produce complete crystallographic specifications, limiting their ability to capture global symmetry and structural dependencies. In particular, current state-of-the-art approaches generate crystals only up to site symmetries and rely on sampling space groups from empirical distributions during generation. Inspired by \emph{spontaneous symmetry breaking} in physics, where crystals break symmetries under external conditions, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework that generates full structure specifications by reversing from the lowest-symmetry priors. Our method leverages a Markovian jump-diffusion process to model these symmetry-breaking dynamics, enabling it to traverse different space groups in a physically motivated manner. translated_title: 通过马尔可夫跳跃扩散实现对称性破缺的全新晶体生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13457v1 公告类型：新 摘要：生成晶体因其在材料科学中的广泛应用而近期受到显著关注。然而，现有生成模型难以生成完整的晶体学规格，限制了其捕捉全局对称性和结构依赖性的能力。特别是，当前最先进的方法仅能生成到位点对称性的晶体，并在生成过程中依赖从经验分布中采样空间群。受物理学中自发对称性破缺（即晶体在外部条件下打破对称性）的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的框架，通过从最低对称性先验反向生成完整结构规格。我们的方法利用马尔可夫跳跃扩散过程来建模这些对称性破缺动力学，使其能够以物理动机驱动的方式在不同空间群之间遍历。我们提出的模型，称为“对称性破缺”
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于马尔可夫跳跃扩散的对称性破缺生成框架，首次实现从低对称性先验反向生成完整晶体结构规格，以物理驱动方式遍历空间群，解决了现有模型无法捕捉全局对称性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a symmetry-breaking generation framework based on Markovian jump-diffusion, which for the first time generates complete crystal structure specifications by reversing from low-symmetry priors, traversing space groups in a physically motivated manner, addressing the limitation of existing models in capturing global symmetry.
